result.note: Tests the named HADR operation to Venezuela: aircraft, cause of the disaster and hospital units deployed.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Operation Amistad, launched by India in June 2026 to assist Venezuela:
items: India dispatched two Indian Air Force C-17 Globemaster aircraft for the mission.
The relief was sent in response to a devastating hurricane.
The deployment included two BHISHM portable hospitals.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the relief was sent in response to a devastating earthquake, not a hurricane. India's HADR deployments have historically focused on the Indian Ocean neighbourhood, so this airlift to Latin America marks a notable extension of that reach.
questions.source: India dispatched two Indian Air Force (IAF) C-17 Globemaster aircraft to Venezuela on 26 June carrying 30 tonnes of relief supplies, six tonnes of medicines, and a 41-member rescue and medical team in response to a devastating earthquake.
